home.name: Akira Schmid
home.news: Jacob Markstrom (upper body) was at Florida's morning skate on Friday, suggesting he is nearing a return, but Schmid will remain between the pipes on Friday against the Winnipeg Jets. Schmid was excellent in his previous outing, also against the Jets, saving 24 of 25 shots (.960 SV%) in a 5-1 win. The 26-year-old Swiss goalie has a 2.99 GAA and .885 SV% in seven games (4-2-1). The Panthers enter Friday's outing as sizeable -217 home favourites against a struggling Jets team on a seven-game losing streak (0-5-2).

home.name: Dustin Wolf
home.news: With Devin Cooley (lower body) expected to miss time, Wolf will have a chance to reestablish himself between the pipes, starting with Friday's game against the Seattle Kraken. Wolf impressed in his rookie season in 2024-25, finishing as the runner-up for the Calder Trophy after posting an impressive 2.64 GAA and .910 SV% in 53 games (29-16-8). That said, he hasn't lived up to those lofty standards since. He has an ugly 4.81 GAA and .839 SV% in six appearances this season (1-4-0). The Flames enter Friday's action as slight -101 home underdogs against a Seattle Kraken team that has won three of their last four (3-1-0).
